name: DashCore
description: Android64 Bismuth-inspired rendering diagnostics for Geometry Dash. Adds viewport-space and camera-coordinate measurements to validate object bounds before any optimization. GPU visibility remains diagnostic only; live render culling is hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Reserved for future testing. DashCore 0.8.1 hard-disables live object hiding; all grouped objects, triggers, and effects remain protected.
